lead_independence.headline: FBI, police investigate possible link in four Treasure Coast bomb threats
lead_independence.lead: The FBI and local police are investigating whether four bomb threats reported across the Treasure Coast over the last eight days are connected. The threats targeted Lawnwood Hospital in Fort Pierce, Indian River State College, and two high schools. Investigators say the email account used to send a threat to Martin County High School had been hacked and may have been connected to a suspect in Russia.
